scaleControls.description: Cabin-fit panel width assumption. Relative layout, not an independent dimension.

overlays.scope: Perspective rectified planar face; assumed aspect checked against round gauges. Does not validate coaming or depth. Controls and labels remain schematic.

panelRectification.method: Projective transform of extrapolated coplanar panel corners; output aspect chosen to approximately preserve circular gauges. Relative comparison only.

limitations: Low-skid B-3 dimensions take precedence over the family 206A schematic; front and side drawing hub heights are not fully consistent.
The PT-HUR panel photograph was projectively rectified using inferred planar corners and round gauges. Absolute face size and cabin depth remain reconstruction assumptions.
Avionics faceplates, annunciators, needles and legends are simplified. This is an assisted simulation, not a systems trainer.
Seats, belt routing, mechanical fittings and cowling sections approximate the cited configuration; no claim of manufacturing-level accuracy.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
